newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Sime ties up with U.K. firm.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Sime ties up with U.K. firm.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate Sime Darby Bhd on Monday entered into a joint venture with W & J Leigh & Co of U.K. to manufacture and market protective and marine coatings.
Sime will hold a 70 percent equity in the joint venture company, Sime Leigh Sdn Bhd, while W & J Leigh will hold 30 percent.

Sime group chief executive Nik Mohamed Yaacob told reporters after the signing that Sime Leigh would initially produce one million litres of coatings a year, using W & J Leigh's technology. The products will initially be available in Malaysia, and later in the rest of Southeast Asia.
Nik Mohamed said China has been identified as a key market.

He said through the joint venture, the Sime group would further consolidate its position in the paints industry. Sime currently makes paint for the household and decorative sectors, and the automotive and industrial sectors.
